verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's IAM docs say it controls who can do what on which resource, which covers resource-level scoping, and describe it as a tool for managing fine-grained permissions. That establishes the core of least-privilege expression. However, the pack never mentions IAM conditions or documents how policies are evaluated, and nothing independent corroborates it. missing for 10: IAM conditions (attribute/time-based policy conditions), documented policy evaluation logic (inheritance, deny precedence), hands-on or independent corroboration.
